files.content: # Alert > Inline status panel for callouts, errors, and notices. Status: beta. This file matches the installed `alert` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/alert.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/alert.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/alert-knobs`: `alertKnobs`, types `AlertKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/alert`: `alertTones`, `Alert`, `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`, `AlertAction`, types `AlertTone`, `AlertProps`, `AlertTitleProps`, `AlertDescriptionProps`, `AlertActionProps` ## Composition ### Anatomy ```tsx ``` ### Dismissible AlertAction takes its own column beside the title, so long text wraps before a dismiss button instead of running under it. ```tsx

// Generated from src/registry/sources/control-ui/recipes/alert.css by scripts/gen-knob-contracts.ts — run `bun run sync:knobs`.
export const alertKnobs = [
  "--cui-alert-radius",
  "--cui-alert-background",
  "--cui-alert-border-color",
  "--cui-alert-shadow",
  "--cui-alert-foreground",
  "--cui-alert-description-foreground",
  "--cui-alert-border-width",
  "--cui-alert-padding",
  "--cui-alert-padding-inline",
  "--cui-alert-gap",
  "--cui-alert-icon-gap",
  "--cui-alert-icon-size",
  "--cui-alert-font-size",
  "--cui-alert-description-gap",
  "--cui-alert-title-font-weight",
] as const;
export type AlertKnobStyle = Partial<Record<(typeof alertKnobs)[number], string>>;
